list.name: engine_type
list.label: Engine
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "telemetry", tag: "engine_type", predicate: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}", start: -30d)

list.name: engine_model
list.label: Engine model
list.query:
import "array"
named = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "engine" and r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.engine_model or exists r.engine_type)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if exists r.engine_model then r.engine_model else r.engine_type}))
  |> group()
none = array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, _value: "not reported"}])
union(tables: [named, none])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Approach Profile — Distance to Next Waypoint vs SOG

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mission" and (r._field == "dist_to_waypoint"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(fn: (column) => column =~ /^(_start|_stop|_measurement|vessel|host|instance|source|engine_type|engine_model)$/)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nav" and (r._field == "sog"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(fn: (column) => column =~ /^(_start|_stop|_measurement|vessel|host|instance|source|engine_type|engine_model)$/)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "autonomy" and (r._field == "waypoint" or r._field == "pause" or r._field == "stationing" or r._field == "returning" or r._field == "armed" or r._field == "comms_lost" or r._field == "manual_override" or r._field == "remote_control" or r._field == "crash_stop"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r._field }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(fn: (column) => column =~ /^(_start|_stop|_measurement|vessel|host|instance|source|engine_type|engine_model)$/)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mission_state" and (r._field == "state"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(fn: (column) => column =~ /^(_start|_stop|_measurement|vessel|host|instance|source|engine_type|engine_model)$/)

from(bucket: "events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "events" and r._field == "message")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "severity"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "Time", _value: "Event", severity: "Severity"})
  |> sort(columns: ["Time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
